cases.title: Coding agent searches with unavailable rg

evidence.source: local Codex and Claude Code history

historical_experiment.interpretation: The current adapted Codex environment avoided the historical error without the Skill. The experiment did not demonstrate an effect.

historical_three_arm_study.environment: Linux/PowerShell 7 adaptation; not Windows replay and not Codex CLI
historical_three_arm_study.interpretation: In this three-task sample, Skill arm avoided four unavailable-rg calls but did not improve answer pass rate and used 15.2% more total tokens than baseline. No statistical significance or general effect is established.

cases.interpretation: Trace status is an execution signal. It does not prove that the requested task failed.

cases.title: Shell command activity in error-marked turns
cases.interpretation: Multiple shell calls do not prove repeated identical commands or a shared root cause. Review traces before converting this cluster to Cases.

caveats: Candidate groups overlap; their counts must not be added to infer a unique failure count.
A candidate signal is not proof that a task failed or that the same root cause recurred.
The 60-turn stratified review queue has no human labels yet; precision and false-positive rate are unknown.
The existing three-task rg fixture has an independent verifier, but the latest Harbor Codex comparison showed no treatment effect.
